description: List a build's sessions: session IDs, status, OS, browser/device, dashboard URL. Takes an Automate or a TRA build id.

buildId.description: Automate hashed build id, or TRA id from listBuildId.

limit.description: Max sessions to return. Defaults to 10.

offset.description: Pagination offset for the REST session list.

sessionType.description: Product the build ran on; the other is also tried.

status.description: Optional session status filter (e.g. done, running, error). Applied client-side.

name: listSessions
